how.mint: Mint in USDG, or in $FLYAI for {pct}% off. While minting is open every fly looks the same, so nobody can pick the rare ones.
how.reveal: Reveal. When minting ends, a future block's hash rolls every fly's traits in the contract itself: rarity (Common, Uncommon, Rare or Legendary), pose, colorway, background and gear. Anyone can check them on chain.
how.activate: Hold $FLYAI. A fly is active while its holder's wallet holds {amount} $FLYAI. Nothing to pay, nothing to press, and one holding covers every fly in the wallet. Active flies trade together on the desk. Every mint split 80% into the flies' trading pool, 20% to the team. When a week ends above the pool's previous high, 95% of that profit goes to active flies in $FLYAI (5% to the team), weighted by rarity and by how long they were active. Registered FLYAI pets, our physical tamagotchis, share it too at 3.5x. Sell a fly or drop under the amount and it stops.
how.risk: Trading can lose money, and a week without profit pays nothing. Nothing here promises a return.

odds.title: Rarity chances
odds.reveal: Every fly looks the same while the mint is open. When it ends (the reveal), a future block's hash rolls every fly's rarity and traits inside the contract, so nobody can pick or see them before, the team included. The counts are exact: there will be 30 Legendary flies, not about 30. Rarity sets a fly's share of the payouts, never how it trades.
odds.traits: Every fly also rolls a pose (14), a colorway (4 per rarity), a background (14), gear (10) and an extra item (13), and the art makes sure no two pictures are alike.

what.grow: Grows up. It hatches from an egg, becomes a larva, then a fly, and evolves into one of five forms (gym, chonk, degen, lover, zen) depending on how you raise it. Level up to unlock hats.
what.care: Needs you. Tap to feed it, hold to pet it. Shake the stick and it gets dizzy, tilt it and it slides, leave it still and it falls asleep. Ignore it and it gets grumpy; overfeed it and it gets fat.
what.play: Games. Swat (30 seconds of fly swatting) and Simon (repeat the neuron pattern). Best scores are saved on the stick.
what.quests: Daily quests and streaks. Three quests a day, a streak for coming back, XP for everything you do.
what.focus: Focus sessions. Plug it into a computer and it guards a 25, 50 or 90 minute timer: pick it up and the session breaks.
what.price: Watches $FLYAI. On Wi-Fi it reacts to the $FLYAI price.
what.friends: Meets other flies. It notices other FLYAI pets nearby over Bluetooth.

chain.order: Pre-order with your wallet, in USDG ($FLYAI holders with 1M+ pay 10% less). The order is recorded on chain.
chain.orderFlyai: Pre-order with your wallet, in USDG or $FLYAI ($FLYAI holders with 1M+ pay 10% less). The order is recorded on chain.
chain.ship: We build and ship your pet to the address you give after ordering.
chain.register: Registered, not minted. Every pet makes its own key on its first start. We add its public address to the pets registry on Robinhood Chain; no NFT is minted.
chain.bind: Link it to your wallet. Plug the stick in; it signs for your wallet, and that wallet receives its share.
chain.share: Shares the desk's profits. Registered pets take a slice of the Trader Flies' weekly profit share at 3.5x, more than a Legendary fly (3x). Always on: no activation needed.
chain.risk: Trading can lose money and a week without profit pays nothing. A pet is a gadget first; nothing here promises a return.

nft.a: No NFT is minted. The pet's own device address is registered on chain, and the pet proves who it is by signing with its key.

wallet.q: Which wallet gets the pet's share?
wallet.a: The wallet you link when you set the stick up. If you give the stick away, the new owner links theirs.

refund.a: Your order is refunded in the same token you paid with.

shipping.a: Shipping is included in the price, worldwide. Any import duties or customs fees in your country are paid by you. We'll announce shipping dates on our channels, and pre-orders are built in order. If we can't ship to your country, your order is refunded.

privacy.a: It's stored privately, used only for shipping, and never goes on chain.

how.title: How it works
how.claim: One free FlightPass per wallet that held a Trader Fly at the 28 Sep snapshot, however many flies it held. Keep at least 1 $FLYAI in the wallet and hit Claim; you only pay gas.
how.free: Every pass starts with about $2.50 of $FLYAI from us. Your fly can play with it, but it never comes out: it stays on the pass.
how.auto: Sign in, turn on the games you want and set your limits. Fly Roulette needs its 18+ terms once; Flybook uses the account you signed in to Flybook with this wallet. The fly's brain still makes the moves, autopilot just clicks for you. Wins aren't guaranteed.
how.money: Top-ups are free. After your first top-up you can withdraw everything above the free $2.50, winnings included, for a {pct}% fee.
how.mine: Hold a pass for a full UTC day and that day's mining points get {x}, on top of your staking tier. One pass counts per wallet.
how.sell: The $FLYAI inside goes with the pass. While it's listed it's frozen (no top-ups, withdrawals or autoplay), so the buyer gets what they saw. A new owner starts with every game switched off.

breedHow.title: How breeding works
breedHow.text: Breeding merges two of your Trader Flies into one stronger fly. It's the only way new traits and rarer flies come into the collection after the mint.
breedHow.s1: Both must be yours. One becomes the child and keeps its number; the other is burned.
breedHow.s2: $0.50 to $5 in $FLYAI, set by the rarer parent. 80% of it is burned for good.
breedHow.s3: The child's traits are rolled from a block that comes after you merge, so nobody can pick the result.
breedHow.s4: Each trait comes from one parent or mutates into something new; rarity is the lower parent's, with a 5% shot at one tier up.
breedHow.why: Fewer flies, rarer flies: every merge takes one fly out of the supply for good, and burns $FLYAI on top.
